/* cppi::41cc0dfe62cfc48f9fb8034b01539ada448ec0744e5c322ca5462f433f2dbbf5 */
WITH
    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-06-03')
    ),

    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-06-03')
    ),

    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    )

SELECT
    trans.trade_date                        AS "Trade Date",
    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    mp.model_portfolio_name                 AS "Model Portfolio Name",
    trans.abor_security_name                AS "Security Name - Current",
    trans.abor_security_id                  AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    trans.model_portfolio_id                AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    trans.business_transaction_code         AS "Business Transaction Code",
    fin.gl_account_name                     AS "Finance Account Name",
    fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency    AS "Finance Trans. - Credit Amount PC",
    fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS "Finance Trans. - Debit Amount PC",
    fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency    AS "Finance Trans. - Credit Amount QC",
    fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS "Finance Trans. - Debit Amount QC"
FROM latest_trans trans
INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
        ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
        ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
       AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
      AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
WHERE trans.rn = 1
  AND fin.rn = 1
ORDER BY trade_date DESC,
         bloomberg_unique_id,
         business_transaction_code,
         gl_account_name

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

	select

		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case

			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (

			, scd.split_level

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD

			select

				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)

		/* METRIC */

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (

/* cppi::1620f76b7679c68b74b63659b130c188256152b0c2d42d9b5030499554414fa4 */
SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
        SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
    ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM account_mapping_query
        UNION
        SELECT
            date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
            '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 JOIN adjusted_date ad ON CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) = ad.business_date
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM account_mapping_query fq
            WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
              AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
        )) T LIMIT 0

WITH latest_meta_run_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(df_meta_run_date) AS max_run_date
    FROM df_trusted_prod.markit_credit_index_component
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
),

    SELECT MAX(file_date) AS max_file_date
    FROM market.markit_credit_index
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'

SELECT

    idx.index_name,
    idx.annex_date,
    idx.index_series,
    idx.index_version,
    idx.index_factor,
    comp.index_clip,
    comp.component_ref_entity_ticker,

    comp.component_ref_entity_red,

-- joins it to ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference data, and applies some
-- light business rules from the BRD related to deployment_disposition, 
-- probability_of_close, capital_usage_component, and transaction_cash_flow_type.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Initial version of query
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-05-12 | gstoffer@cppib.com

-- - Fixed probability_of_close which did not have the correct logic
--   because the BRD was using incorrect wording (opportunities/deals
--   in the data warehouse close, they don't exit)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers

  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  staging.funding_currency,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,

  staging.market_value,

  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,

  --------------------------------------
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(staging.expected_funding_date AS DATE)
       > TRY_CAST(staging.business_date         AS DATE)
    THEN COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 80)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Net Income and Expenses'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'Net Purchases and Sales'
    ELSE NULL

  CASE
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Internal Transfer'
    WHEN reference.asset_category = 'Aggregate Projection Shell' THEN 'Aggregate Drawdown/Distribution Projection'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Income Only'
    ELSE 'Investment Funding/Distribution'
  END AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------

  null AS unadjusted_exit_projection,

  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates

  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_ledger_projections_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,

  --------------------------------------
  -- null on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,

  NULL AS ticket_number,

  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group

  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier
  AND reference.run_id = '8d56eac5-859d-4029-8bb0-a339a7c7f791'
WHERE
  staging.run_id = '8d56eac5-859d-4029-8bb0-a339a7c7f791'

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%7'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-17'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%7'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-17'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%7'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

	where

	select *
	from (
		select * from original_data
		union all

/* QuickSight 808b2394-3fea-4a05-b72d-3d20ea533654 */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:

			 */
			select

				, pnl_4yp_rc

					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

		/* VALUE */

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:

			select

				, pnl_4yp_rc

				/* TOTAL FUND */

					and periods_per_year = 365

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

		from

		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

		/* VALUE */

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

		from

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 21:25:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date

		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null

		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2

	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

with 
	TOTAL_PV as
	  (
	    select fact.analytic_value as pv
	    from radar_reporting_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact
	    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_chron c on fact.chron_id = c.chron_id
	    join radar_reporting_prod.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node on fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID and fact.chron_id = node.chron_id
	    where
		  c.business_date = '2025-06-16'
	      AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
	      AND fact.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
	      AND node.node_level = 1
		  AND node.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
		  and c.canonical_source = '1'
	  ),
	category_limits as
	  (
	    select 'FI' as category, pv * 0.3 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BBB' as category, pv * 0.0625 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BB' as category, pv * 0.0525 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select '<= B' as category, pv * 0.0425 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	  ),
	WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI as
	  (
	    select
          parent.party_name,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and parent.gics_sector = 'Financials' then credit_exposure else 0 end) as fi_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as bbb_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^BB[\+\-]?$' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as bb_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as b_or_below_ce
        from
		  radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
          radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
		  radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
        where fact.business_date = '2025-06-16'
          and fact.business_date = child.business_date
          and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
          AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		  AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
          AND NOT ( (parent.is_government = 'Y' OR parent.is_provincial = 'Y' ) AND parent.domicile_country_code in ('US', 'CA') )
        group by parent.party_name
	  ),
	  summary_ce as 
	  (
	  select *
	    from
	      (
	        select
	          v.*,
	           sum(fi_ce) over () as sum_fi_ce,
               sum(bbb_ce) over () as sum_bbb_ce,
               sum(bb_ce) over () as sum_bb_ce,
               sum(b_or_below_ce) over () as sum_b_or_below_ce,
               row_number() over ( order by fi_ce desc ) as fi_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by bbb_ce desc ) as bbb_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by bb_ce desc ) as bb_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by b_or_below_ce desc ) as b_or_below_ce_rank
	        from WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI v
	      )
	      CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
	        array['FI', 'BBB', 'BB', '<=B'], array[fi_ce, bbb_ce, bb_ce, b_or_below_ce], array[sum_fi_ce, sum_bbb_ce, sum_bb_ce, sum_b_or_below_ce], array[fi_ce_rank, bbb_ce_rank, bb_ce_rank, b_or_below_ce_rank]
	      ) as t(category, top_exposure, total_exposure, rank)
	     where rank = 1
	     )
	     select
	  ce.category,
	  total_exposure / 1000000 AS total_exposure,
	  limit / 1000000 AS limit,
	  ROUND( total_exposure / limit * 100, 1) AS limit_util,
	  case
	    WHEN limit IS NULL OR limit >= total_exposure THEN 'OK'
	    ELSE 'BREACH'
	  END AS status,
	  party_name AS top_issuer_name,
	  top_exposure / 1000000 AS top_exposure
	FROM summary_ce ce, category_limits cl
	WHERE ce.category = cl.category and limit IS NOT NULL AND limit < total_exposure
	order by case WHEN ce.category = 'FI' THEN 1 WHEN ce.category = 'BBB' THEN 2 WHEN ce.category = 'BB' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

/* cppi::7e498713efc33640de01f8f1d2cdcbd0cc83fc13dc79e3035e129636ca447847 */
Select
    Null                                as InstrumentDetails,
    SEC.scd_id                          as ClientInstrumentID,
    SEC.origination_date                as InformationDate,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment = 'True' Then 'Yes'
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment  = 'True' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End                                 as CreditSpreadAdjustmentIsApplicable,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment = 'True' Then CASH_COUPON.colc_spread_adjustment
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment = 'True'  Then PIK_COUPON.colc_spread_adjustment
        Else Null
    End                                 as CreditSpreadAdjustment,
--////////////// START OF THE CASH SECTION //////////////////////////
    Case WHEN CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is null then 'No' Else 'Yes' End as PaysCashInterest,
    Null                                as CashStartDate,
    Null                                as CashEndDate,
    Null                                as CashAccruedAmount,
    Case WHEN CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is null then Null Else
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End End                                 as CashInterestIsFloating,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then CASH_COUPON.colc_index_name
        Else Null
    End                                 as CashBaseRateIndex,   -- Needs translation table
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then 'No' Else
    Case When sched.value_decimal is not null Then 'Yes' 
         Else 'No'
    End End                                 as CashBaseRateIndexIsCappedFloored,
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else
    Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'   Then sched.value_decimal
         Else Null
    End End                                 as CashBaseRateIndexCap,
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else
    Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexFloor' Then sched.value_decimal
         Else Null
    End End                                 as CashBaseRateIndexFloor,
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else 'Fixed' End as CashMarginType,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then CASH_COUPON.colc_spread
        Else CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_rate
    End                                 as CashFixedSpreadAmount,
    Null                                as CashMetric,
    Null                                as CashMetricValueMarginGrid,
    --For Loans default the CashTotalInterestRateIsCappedFloored to No, Null,NUll
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else 'No'  End  as CashTotalInterestRateIsCappedFloored,
    Null                                  as CashTotalInterestRateCap,
    Null                                  as CashTotalInterestRateFloor,
    CASH_COUPON.colc_day_count_name       as CashDayCountConvention, 
--////////////// END OF THE CASH SECTION //////////////////////////    
--*************************************PIK SECTION **************************************************************************
--NEED TO TEST IF A PIK CONTRACT EXISTS AND NULL THIS ENTIRE SECTION IF IT DOES NOT.
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is null then 'No' Else 'Yes' End as PaysPIKInterest,
    Null                                as PIKStartDate,
    Null                                as PIKEndDate,
    Null                                as PIKAccruedAmount,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'

    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_index_name
        Else Null
    End End                                 as PIKBaseRateIndex,   --NEEDS TRANSLATION TABLE
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else 
			Case When sched.value_decimal is not null Then 'Yes' 
	         	 Else 'No'
    End	End    		                         as PIKBaseRateIndexIsCappedFloored,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    		Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'   Then sched.value_decimal
	         Else Null
    End End                                  as PIKBaseRateIndexCap,

    		Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexFloor' Then sched.value_decimal

    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_spread

    Null                                    as PIKMetricValueMarginGrid,

    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_has_cap_rate   = 'True' or  PIK_COUPON.colc_has_floor_rate = 'True' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateIsCappedFloored,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_has_cap_rate   = 'True' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_cap_rate
        Else Null
    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateCap,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_has_floor_rate = 'True' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_floor_rate
        Else Null
    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateFloor,
    PIK_COUPON.colc_day_count_name          as PIKDayCountConvention     --NEEDS TRANSLATION TABLE
FROM
    reference.ci_sentry_security SEC
    left join (	Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,
					COUP.colc_first_accrual_date, COUP.colc_fixed_rate, COUP.colc_fixed_floating, COUP.colc_spread, COUP.colc_index_name,
					colc_day_count_name, colc_payment_frequency, colc_pay_convention, facility_maturity_date, loan_contract_status,
					COUP.colc_include_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_has_cap_rate,COUP.colc_has_floor_rate,
					COUP.colc_cap_rate,COUP.colc_floor_rate,TRD.quantity_net,COUP.colc_all_in_rate,
					ROW_NUMBER()  OVER( Partition by (COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, loan_contract_identifier)
					Order By COUP.security_identifier, COUP.loan_contract_status, COUP.loan_contract_type, TRD.quantity_net desc, COUP.loan_contract_identifier desc ) AS Row
                        --Note The loan_contract_status orders - Active, Matured, Not_Traded.
				From
					reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon COUP
					left join (Select security_identifier,sum(cast( quantity_net as decimal(19,5) )) as quantity_net --This security_identifier is a loan_contract_identifier
								From  trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions
								Where security_type = 'loanContract' and transaction_code in ('ROLL+','ROLL-')
									and transaction_type = 'transaction' and is_cancelled = 'False' and date(trade_date) <= date('2025-06-13')
								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type <> 'PIK'
					and business_date = '2025-06-13'
				) CASH Where Row = 1 AND CASH.quantity_net <> 0	 and CASH.colc_all_in_rate <> 0 
			)	CASH_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = CASH_COUPON.security_identifier
    left join ( Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,
					COUP.colc_first_accrual_date, COUP.colc_fixed_rate, COUP.colc_fixed_floating, COUP.colc_spread, COUP.colc_index_name,
					COUP.colc_day_count_name, COUP.colc_payment_frequency, COUP.colc_pay_convention, COUP.facility_maturity_date, COUP.loan_contract_status,
					COUP.colc_include_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_has_cap_rate,COUP.colc_has_floor_rate,
					COUP.colc_cap_rate,COUP.colc_floor_rate,TRD.quantity_net, COUP.colc_all_in_rate,
					ROW_NUMBER()  OVER( Partition by (COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, loan_contract_identifier)
					Order By COUP.security_identifier, COUP.loan_contract_status, COUP.loan_contract_type, TRD.quantity_net desc, COUP.loan_contract_identifier desc ) AS Row
                        --Note The loan_contract_status orders - Active, Matured, Not_Traded.
				From
					reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon COUP
					left join (Select security_identifier,sum(cast(quantity_net as decimal(19,5) ))  as quantity_net --This security_identifier is a loan_contract_identifier
								From  trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions
								Where security_type = 'loanContract' and transaction_code in ('ROLL+','ROLL-')
									and transaction_type = 'transaction' and is_cancelled = 'False' and date(trade_date) <= date('2025-06-13')
								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type = 'PIK'
					and COUP.business_date = '2025-06-13'
				) PIK Where Row = 1	AND PIK.quantity_net <> 0 AND PIK.colc_all_in_rate <> 0	
			) PIK_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = PIK_COUPON.security_identifier
	left join (select sched.* from reference.ci_sentry_security_schedules sched
                    where
                    sched.business_date = '2025-06-13' 
                    and sched.end_date <> '' 
                    and date('2025-06-13') between date(sched.start_date) and date(sched.end_date)
                    and sched.schedule_name in ('CreditFacility_IndexFloor', 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'))  sched on SEC.security_identifier = sched.security_identifier
where
    date('2025-06-13') between date(SEC.start_date) and date(SEC.end_date)    
    and SEC.sentry_security_type IN ('termLoanFacility','delayedDrawLoanFacility','revolvingCreditFacility')
    and SEC.scd_id in ('PD1000856')
Order by
	SEC.scd_id

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

var.benchmark_name,
var.hierarchy_type,
var.hierarchy_node,
var.node_name,
var.node_level,
CAST(var.var95 AS decimal(22,6)) as var95,
CAST(b.mean AS decimal(22,6)) as mean,
CAST(c.vol AS decimal(22,6)) as vol,
CAST(d.cs01 AS decimal(22,6)) as cs01,
CAST(e.dv01 AS decimal(22,6)) as dv01,
CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, node_name, node_level, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_var
where business_date = '2025-06-16' 
and benchmark_name = 'ATP CORE' and hierarchy_type = 'POOL'
and analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' and percent_confidence_level = 95 and run_id = 'ATP_CORE'
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_name, node_level, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_mean 
where business_date = '2025-06-16' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.node_name = var.node_name and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
and b.node_level = var.node_level
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_name, node_level, analytic_value as "vol", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_vol

radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_dv01

/* cppi::dff2796c320ddcd550e34acb1cab6d6c9a9baa7ab480a5c19c18e5ebd5000054 */
/* QuickSight ecba0eaa-cade-4efb-b9b9-f364c342efe0 */
SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaptions|option|future|contract|deposit|paper|collateralized|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final) AS "holdings_search_holdings_lookthrough"
